summary: Completed testing of admin features: user block/unblock and reservation management. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Admin can block/unblock non-admin users, blocked users get 403 when creating reservations, admin can view all reservations with filters and cancel any active reservation.

issues: Console warnings: Chart width/height -1 errors - recharts library issue with container sizing, not a blocker

critical_code_review_comments: Block/unblock APIs properly protect admin users from being blocked (returns 400)
Blocked users correctly receive 403 with appropriate error message when trying to create reservation
Admin reservations endpoint correctly filters by building_id, status, and date
UI correctly shows Active/Blocked status badges and red background for blocked users
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin features fully working: block/unblock users (PUT /api/users/{id}/block|unblock), admin reservations management (GET/PUT /api/admin/reservations). All users are currently unblocked. user.test@cebuana.com was blocked and unblocked during testing - currently unblocked. One reservation was cancelled during admin cancel testing.

Backend: PUT /api/admin/reservations/{id}/cancel - admin cancels reservation successfully
